Don’t mistake me, my dear. Who can name him? Who? Who can testify: “I believe in him”? And who with life and feeling still in his body can with any honesty say: “I don't believe in him”? The All-Embracing, the All-Sustaining, doesn’t he embrace and sustain you, me, himself? Doesn't the sky arch above us? Doesn't the earth stand firm beneath us? And the stars, the eternal stars, don’t they look kindly down upon us? And when we look into each other’s eyes, doesn’t all this press in on your heart and mind, weaving a presence around you, seen and unseen, an eternal mystery? Let if in, fill your heart with this to overflowing, and when it’s reached its peak, when your bliss can grow no stronger, then call it what you will! Love! Happiness! Soul! God! I have no name for it. Feeling is everything.
translation:
@@U01618@@
别误会我，亲爱的。谁能说出他的名字？ WHO？谁能作证：“我相信他”？谁的身体里还有生命和感觉，可以诚实地说：“我不相信他”？一切包容者、一切维持者，他不是拥抱和维持你、我、他自己吗？我们头顶上不是有拱形的天空吗？地球难道不是坚定地矗立在我们脚下吗？还有那些星星，那些永恒的星星，它们不是在温柔地俯视着我们吗？当我们看着彼此的眼睛时，这一切难道不会压在你的心灵和思想上，在你周围编织出一种可见的和不可见的存在，一个永恒的谜团吗？让它进来，用它充满你的心，直到溢出，当它达到顶峰，当你的幸福无法变得更强大时，你想怎么称呼它就怎么称呼它！爱！幸福！灵魂！上帝！我不知道它的名字。感觉就是一切。
